title: Comprehensive machine learning-generated classifier identifies pro-metastatic characteristics and predicts individual treatment in pancreatic cancer: A multicenter cohort study based on super-enhancer
summary: PubMed/PMC primary full-text record gives the exact DOI/title and article text. Methods describe 1,705 patients across 14 cohorts and 188 ML integrations for SEMet; Results link classification to metastatic phenotype and treatment response, with mouse validation. This record is limited to the study result and does not establish independent replication or real-world benefit.
